messages:
chris_pm: Ok folks — need a short, actionable rollout/experiment spec for the 'gradual fallback' change (model variant + prefix-caching tweak). Goal: reduce tail cost while preserving quality. I want: launch acceptance criteria, ramp schedule, auto-rollback triggers, and per-customer pinning behavior. Can we lock this by EOD?

emma_devx: +1 on scope. I'll draft a concise PRD section but need concrete metrics. Proposal: primary metric = downstream quality regression measured via our eval set (QA F1) and user-facing page completion rate. Secondary = latency P95 and error rate.

raj_eng: For rollout mechanics, suggest staged percentages and a config we can feed into the router. Example config: 
```yaml
rollout: gradual-fallback-v1
stages:
  - pct: 1
    hold: 30m
  - pct: 10
    hold: 2h
  - pct: 50
    hold: 6h
  - pct: 100
    hold: 24h
pin_policy:
  allow_customer_pin: true
  pin_ttl_hours: 168  # 7 days
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  window: 5m
```

maria_sre: Nice. SRE rollback thresholds: automatic rollback if any of the following sustained for window=5m:
- user-facing error rate increase > 0.4 percentage points absolute (e.g., 0.6% -> 1.1%)
- latency P95 increase > 20% relative
- availability drop > 0.5%
Also require manual approval for rollbacks at >50% traffic. Add alerting channels -> #incidents and on-call pager if auto-rollback fires.

oliver_data: For experiment analysis: track these cohorts separately: routed fallback users vs baseline. Metrics to compute: QA F1 delta, completion_rate delta, downstream retention (1d), tokens_per_request, and cost_per_1000_tokens. We should compute two-sided 95% CI and require delta bounds exclude -1.5% QA F1 (non-inferiority margin). Minimum sample sizes: to detect 1.5% absolute QA F1 drop at 80% power, we need ~25k requests per cohort (rough estimate).

emma_devx: Acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- No statistically significant QA F1 regression beyond -1.5% non-inferiority margin after 24h at >=50% traffic.
- Latency P95 increase <= 10% at full ramp.
- Error rate no more than +0.2pp at full ramp.
- Cost per 1k tokens reduced vs baseline by >=5% (optional win metric).
If any hard thresholds (latency P95 >20% or error increase >0.5pp) occur in any stage, rollback immediately.

raj_eng: Implementation notes: router will tag requests with `rollout=gradual-fallback-v1` and `variant=fallback` so we can slice metrics. Customer pinning: API `/pin_customer(customer_id, version, ttl_hours)` will create override. Pins should bypass routing but still emit metrics. TTL default 168h as above and ops can revoke early.

chris_pm: Quick question on pins — do we allow unlimited pins? Some customers asked for long-term pinning.

emma_devx: We should allow enterprise long-term pins via an approval flow (support->account exec->ops) but default UI/API will limit self-serve pins to 7 days to avoid shadowing rollouts. Document in PRD.

maria_sre: Add a canary checklist for each stage: 
- synthetic smoke tests (success rate >99% over 5m)
- tracing sampled at 1% for new variant
- cost monitoring enabled
- circuit breaker configured (fail open to baseline variant if backend issues)
Also include a post-mortem template if rollback triggered.

oliver_data: I'll attach a minimal SQL for cohort split reports in the PRD later, for now: `SELECT variant, COUNT(*) as n, avg(qa_f1) as mean_f1, avg(latency_ms) FROM events WHERE rollout='gradual-fallback-v1' GROUP BY variant;`

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout `gradual-fallback-v1` created by chris_pm — start=1769980200 (in 1h) · stages: [1%,10%,50%,100%] · auto_rollback=ON

chris_pm: This is great. Emma — can you convert these bullets into the PRD acceptance section and add the short runbook? Raj — can you add the YAML to the router repo and a feature flag? Maria — please draft the alert playbook snippets. Oliver — attach the SQL and sample size calc. Target: doc + basic infra by EOD tomorrow.

emma_devx: Will do, ping me on DM if anyone has objections to thresholds. :thumbsup:

raj_eng: I'll open a draft PR for the router config and feature flag now.

maria_sre: I'll put the playbook in incidents/wiki and link from PRD.

oliver_data: I'll validate sample size with real variance tomorrow morning and post numbers.

chris_pm: Thanks — closing the thread for now, but keep replies in this thread for any last-minute changes.
